tools_addBackupNote: Paste the codes the service gave you, or type them. Kemlock splits them for you, one to a line or separated by commas or spaces, and leaves out a code that is there twice.
tools_addTagPlaceholder: Add a tag, then press Enter
tools_backupCodesHint: They stay in your vault, sealed like everything else.
tools_backupCodesPlaceholder: One code to a line, or separated by commas or spaces
tools_breachAdvice: Change this service’s password, and turn on two-step sign-in if you haven’t. Make new backup codes if the service lets you.
tools_breachCredit: Breach data from Have I Been Pwned ({source}), licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0.
tools_breachesNote: Services of your codes and backup codes that have a breach listed since you added them. Nothing from your vault is sent to check.
tools_coverageAll: Every code has its backup codes saved, or is marked as giving none.
tools_coverageNote: {covered} of {total} codes have their backup codes saved.
tools_deleteBackupBody: Its {count} codes are removed from the vault, on every device that syncs it.
tools_deleteTagBody: It comes off {count} items. The items stay.
tools_duplicatesCard: Find items the vault holds twice
tools_duplicatesNote: Items the vault holds more than once, by the app’s own rules. Look at a group, then merge it into one item or say it is not a duplicate.
tools_itemGone: This item is no longer in the vault.
tools_lowCodes: Two codes or fewer are left for {name}. Get more from the service before they run out.
tools_matchingExplainLearns: The server learns which of your logins share a site, a username and a password, and nothing else about them.
tools_matchingExplainNever: It never learns a password, and it suggests groups that Kemlock checks again before it shows them. Turning this off deletes what it holds.
tools_matchingExplainSends: Turning this on sends the server a keyed fingerprint of each login, made here under a key it doesn’t hold.
tools_mergedSkipped: Merged: {count} removed. {skipped} left out: they are in a space you can only read.
tools_noBreaches: No service of yours has a new breach listed.
tools_noCodesDetected: No codes found in that text yet.
tools_noTagsYet: No tags yet. Tag a code or a login below.
tools_notDuplicatesSaved: Remembered: this group stays hidden until another copy joins it.
tools_nothingToCheck: Nothing to check: turn on the breached-passwords check in Settings, or the daily refresh below.
tools_nothingToOrder: Nothing to put in order yet.
tools_onDevice: Everything here is found in this browser. Nothing is sent.
tools_onDeviceServer: Found in this browser; the server may suggest groups of logins, which are checked here first.
tools_reason_sameAccount: The same account with two passwords
tools_refreshDetail: Asks Have I Been Pwned once a day for breaches newer than the list Kemlock ships. The same request goes from everyone and carries nothing from your vault.
tools_reorderCodesNote: Drag a code, or use its Move up and Move down buttons. The order is kept in your vault, so your phone shows it too.
tools_reorderLoginsNote: Drag a login, or use its Move up and Move down buttons. This order is for this browser only: your phone sorts logins by name.
tools_reviewKept: Websites and tags are joined. A password you don’t keep goes among the previous passwords of the one that stays.
tools_reviewSkipped: {count} of these items are in a space you can only read, so they are left out of the merge.
tools_reviewNote: Pick the item that stays and, where the copies differ, the value to keep. The newest is picked for you. The others are removed, and you can undo the merge for 30 days.
tools_serverMatchingDetail: Lets Kemlock Server suggest groups of logins. Off, everything is found in this browser.
tools_stale: This changed since you looked at it. The list is shown again as it is now.
tools_tagDeletedSkipped: Tag deleted from {count} items. {skipped} left as they are: they are in a space you can only read.
tools_tagRenamedSkipped: Tag renamed on {count} items. {skipped} left as they are: they are in a space you can only read.
tools_undoEditedBody: The item that stayed was changed after the merge. Undoing puts it back as it was before the merge, and those changes are lost.
tools_undoMergeNote: A merge can be undone for 30 days.
